== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[IT-O (Eyetee-Oh) (Japanese)|IT-O (Eyetee-Oh)]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/156625010/gkaW2v8nG0-18soGvddCEA.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 89673866.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>1d03a80c1db8c509748d6069fc0adb9071811f823ae09db9209b59c711ff817f</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
